'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Gogolen DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Rocking My Peers Putting Suckers In Fear
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
